user.title: Set up Keyframe Scheduler
user.description: Create a new Keyframe Scheduler instance – one instance is one schedule for any number of lights.

init.title: Schedule & lights
init.description:
Schedule: in the webapp click '⬇️ Save as file', open the file in a text editor and paste its content here.

Lights: the integration controls the selected lights itself – only while they are on, it never switches them on. When switched on they take the current values at once.

Manual change (app, scene, switch): the light pauses. Switching it off and on again always resumes.

data.resume_mode: Follow again after a manual change
data.detect_non_ha_changes: Also detect changes made at the device (e.g. wall dimmer on the bus)
data.adjust_types: Adjust light type timings (shown on the last page after “Submit”)

light_types.title: Light types
light_types.description: The type sets the longest fade per command and how often commands are sent. Groups: the type applies to all members.

type_params.title: Light type timings
type_params.description: Max. transition = longest fade per command. Min. interval = shortest time between two commands to the same light. The defaults are conservative – adjust them to your installation.

data.hue_min_interval: Philips Hue: min. interval between commands
data.generic_min_interval: Generic / WLAN: min. interval between commands
